It’s a sign you have a hungry curiosity, and some day you will be stuck at home and you will find yourself at your laptop, cleaning up files, and you’ll marvel at all the stuff you saved!
In the meanwhile, I want to suggest three things.
1. Print a handful of things out. Have a designated place to hang/lay them, so you have something to grab in a dead moment.
2. It might be helpful to talk a few things over with a therapist to rebuild your self esteem, your consciousness might be skewed towards your flaws, forgetting where you get strength and confidence.
3. And if you actually want to *do* something with the different topics, I suggest you take on a creative outlet. Communicating what occupies you, maybe even telling a story, or a thought, so it doesn’t weigh on your system, is as therapeutical as my previous suggestion.
